name: Mono Glass
css:
/* Mono Glass: inverted manga panel behind frosted panes */
[data-workspace-area="conversation"] {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 40% 50%, rgba(10,10,12,0.55), rgba(10,10,12,0.25) 70%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(10,10,12,0.45), rgba(10,10,12,0.65)),
    linear-gradient(#fff, #fff),
    url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") !important;
  background-blend-mode: normal, normal, difference, normal !important;
  background-size: cover, cover, cover, cover !important;
  background-position: center, center, center, 75% 40% !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
}
.messages-timeline-scroll { background: transparent !important; }

/* Sidebar: light behind, frosted pane on top */
[data-slot="sidebar"] {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 40% at 0% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 35% at 100% 100%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), transparent 65%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #151517 0%, #0c0c0e 100%) !important;
}
[data-slot="sidebar-inner"] {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(115%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(115%);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
}
[data-thread-item] {
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: background-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}
[data-thread-item]:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
[data-thread-item][aria-current="page"], [data-thread-item][data-active="true"] {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #e4e4e7, inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}

/* Frosted header */
[data-chat-header] {
  background: rgba(28,28,32,0.50) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(115%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(115%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06) !important;
}

/* Your messages: clear glass, monospace like a neovim buffer */
[data-user-message-bubble] {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(115%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(115%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.30), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;
  font-size: 0.92em;
}

/* Code blocks: darker glass */
.chat-markdown-codeblock {
  background: rgba(10,10,12,0.60) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07) !important;
}

/* Composer: floating glass card, brighter edge on focus */
[data-slot="composer-host"] {
  background: rgba(34,34,38,0.55) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(115%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(115%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.40), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  transition: box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s;
}
[data-slot="composer-host"]:focus-within {
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.40), 0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}
.composer-tiptap { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; }

/* Popups: frosted */
[data-slot="menu-popup"], [data-slot="popover-popup"], [data-slot="dialog-popup"], [data-slot="tooltip-popup"] {
  background: rgba(20,20,23,0.78) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(115%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(36px) saturate(115%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) !important;
}

/* Thin grey scrollbars */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); }
[data-slot="scroll-area-thumb"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16) !important; }

svg.lucide { stroke-width: 1.75; }
